business_problem: Rezolve Ai’s legacy product discovery system relied on a contextual, AI-based search engine that excelled with subjective queries. However, the system could not support the precise searches that B2B customers required.
solution_summary: Rezolve Ai’s legacy product discovery system relied on a contextual, AI-based search engine that excelled with subjective queries.
